label: configurator • update a schedule's time
query: Change my schedule "Morning Brief" to run at 07:00 instead.
notes: A time patch is an automations entry (schedule source) carrying the new frequency_time_of_day (merge semantics patch the existing schedule by name). A REAL daily 08:30 schedule is seeded under the referenced name (owned by a seeded custom agent) so the retime is an actual change an inspect-first model can ground in live state instead of dead-ending on not-found.
